y-m-06-05.title: Lelona nani lincinci labafundi onokuba nabo ophumeleleyo?
y-m-06-05.topic: Ukufunda idatha: ubudlelwane phakathi kwento ekhethwe kakhulu nenani elipheleleyo labantu
y-m-06-05.goal: Vavanya isitatimenti esithi "ophumeleleyo ubuncinane uyisiqingatha sesixa sonke" ngokwenza imizekelo echasayo, uze usebenze ukuba ophumeleleyo kufuneka abe nabafundi abangaphi ubuncinane ukuze kubekho ophumeleleyo omnye kuphela.
y-m-06-05.material:
Abafundi abangama-20 bakhetha imenyu enye yesidlo sasemini sesikolo phakathi kwe-tteokbokki, i-gimbap, i-ramyeon, kunye needumplings. Umntu ngamnye wakhetha enye kuphela. Xa kukho imenyu enye kuphela ekhethwe kakhulu, siyibiza ngokuthi "ophumeleleyo." Ukuba inani elifanayo lelona likhulu, sithi akukho ophumeleleyo.
UJaei wathi, "Imenyu ephumeleleyo kufuneka ikhethwe ngabafundi abali-10 ubuncinane. Siqingatha sama-20."

y-m-06-05.s.s1.o.a: Yenza enye itheyibhile apho ophumeleleyo anabafundi abali-10.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.r.a: Imeko yesi-10 sele ihambelana nesitatimenti. Ukufumanisa ukuba ikho itheyibhile ephikisana nesitatimenti, kufuneka ukhangele enye imeko.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.o.b: Yenza itheyibhile apho iimenyu zonke ezine zinenani elifanayo.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.r.b: Ukuba zonke ziyafana, akukho ophumeleleyo, ngoko awunakuvavanya isitatimenti.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.o.c: Cinga ukuba uJaei ulungile uze ufune isizathu.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.r.c: Ukuba uqala ngengcinga yokuba ichanekile uze ufune izizathu kuphela, usenokugqithisa iimeko apho isitatimenti siphukayo.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.o.d: Yenza itheyibhile apho ophumeleleyo enabafundi abangaphantsi kwabali-10.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.r.d: Oku kucinga kuzama ukwenza wena umzekelo ophikisana nesitatimenti.

y-m-06-05.s.s3.explain: Ukuba ophumeleleyo unabali-5, ezinye iimenyu ezintathu zinabafundi aba-4 okanye ngaphantsi nganye, ngoko 5+4+4+4=17 ayifikeleli kuma-20. Nge-6, unokwenza 6+5+5+4=20. Ngoko ophumeleleyo unabafundi aba-6 ubuncinane.
